_doc: TPCR-TWEET-RESTYLE-CUTOVER: the ONLY place the format window and the new-format reply tiers are set. reply_tier_a/reply_tier_b: |observed - forecast| WTI cutoffs, set by Fred Oct 28 2026 to A=3.0, B=6.0 (miss <= A ✅, A < miss <= B ⬇️/⬆️, > B ⏬/⏫; unset or invalid = new-format reply skipped_bad_config). Read by operations/scripts/tweet_format.py. Times are America/New_York (EDT, UTC-4, on both dates; DST ends 02:00 Nov 1, after old_retires).
